name: EPM_Remote Access Tool Privilege Elevation Activity
xql_query:
// ============================================================
// Rule: EPM_Remote Access Tool Privilege Elevation Activity
// Vendor: BeyondTrust
// Objective:
// Detect activity associated with EPM_Remote Access Tool Privilege Elevation Activity.
// Severity: SEV_040_HIGH
// Category: EXECUTION
// ============================================================
// MITRE ATT&CK:
// Tactic: TA0011 - Command and Control
// Technique: T1219.002 - Remote Access Software

config case_sensitive = false

| dataset = beyondtrust_epm_raw

| filter is_epm_event = true
| filter is_epm_privilege_event = true
| filter epm_event_code in (100, 112)

| alter
    epm_process_command_line = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.command_line"),
    epm_process_title = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.title"),
    epm_parent_process_name = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.parent.name"),
    epm_parent_process_path = json_extract_scalar(process, "$.parent.executable"),
    process_name_lc = lowercase(process_name),
    process_path_lc = lowercase(process_path),
    process_title_lc = lowercase(epm_process_title),
    parent_process_name_lc = lowercase(epm_parent_process_name),
    parent_process_path_lc = lowercase(epm_parent_process_path)

// Exact executable families plus path/title context
| filter
    process_name_lc ~= "^(anydesk|teamviewer|rustdesk|screenconnect|connectwisecontrol|atera|splashtop).*\\.exe$"
    or process_name_lc in ("srmanager.exe", "strwinclt.exe", "splashtopremote.exe")
    or parent_process_name_lc ~= "^(anydesk|teamviewer|rustdesk|screenconnect|connectwisecontrol|atera|splashtop).*\\.exe$"
    or process_path_lc ~= ".*\\\\(anydesk|teamviewer|rustdesk|screenconnect|connectwise control|atera networks|splashtop)\\\\.*"
    or parent_process_path_lc ~= ".*\\\\(anydesk|teamviewer|rustdesk|screenconnect|connectwise control|atera networks|splashtop)\\\\.*"
    or process_title_lc ~= ".*(anydesk|teamviewer|rustdesk|screenconnect|connectwise control|splashtop).*"

| fields
    _time,
    epm_event_code,
    event_type,
    event_message,
    risk_level,
    endpoint_name,
    endpoint_id,
    endpoint_ip,
    epm_username,
    user_domain,
    process_name,
    process_path,
    epm_process_command_line,
    epm_process_title,
    epm_parent_process_name,
    epm_parent_process_path
description: Detectar elevação ou requisito de elevação envolvendo ferramentas de acesso remoto e RMM. Correlaciona Event IDs 100/112 com nomes, títulos, caminhos e processo pai associados a AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk, ScreenConnect/ConnectWise Control, Atera e Splashtop.
alert_name: EPM_Remote Access Tool Privilege Elevation Activity
alert_description: Foi identificada atividade de privilégio envolvendo a ferramenta de acesso remoto $process_name no endpoint $endpoint_name , executada pelo usuário $epm_username a partir de $process_path . O SOC deve validar se a ferramenta e a sessão remota são autorizadas.
